name: A Discovery of Witches
description: Closet witch Diana Bishop and centuries-old vampire Matthew Clairmont are drawn into a deadly mystery and forbidden romance when a magical book shows up in an Oxford library.

videos.title: A Discovery of Witches S2 - First Look
videos.overview: Matthew and Diana head to Elizabethan London to find a teacher to harness Diana's powers.

videos.title: Creating Elizabethan London
videos.overview: Be transported back to Elizabethan London and get a behind-the-scenes peek at how 1590s London was brought to life.

videos.title: Can Love Survive?
videos.overview: The Sky original based on the Deborah Harkness stories returns for season two, as Matthew and Diana head to Elizabethan London to find a teacher to harness Diana's powers.

videos.title: A Discovery of Witches: The Story
videos.overview: Relive the story so far. Meet the new characters who inhabit the fascinating and treacherous world of Elizabethan London.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Things get creepy for historian and closet witch Diana Bishop when she calls up a magical manuscript. Her discovery is about to throw her back into the world of magic and into the path of Matthew Clairmont, a centuries old vampire.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Matthew fights to control his cravings, he leaves Diana to face her enemies alone. And those include powerful witch Peter Knox.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Diana and Matthew's relationship moves forward. But something's about to happen that will cast them both further into danger.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Diana gets a chilly welcome when she seeks safety at the Clairmont family home. Back in Oxford, trouble is brewing.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Matthew crosses a dangerous line when he returns to Oxford. Diana discovers his dark past, before something unexpected tears them apart.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Matthew and Baldwin race to save Diana from Satu's dangerous dark magic. In Oxford, Sophie shocks Agatha with a confession.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Diana's aunts' home gives up all sorts of secrets when Diana and Matthew pay a visit. Danger looms as Juliette breaks free from Gerbert.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With danger at every turn, Diana and Matthew are forced to run. But will they escape in time? Series finale.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Reluctant witch Diana Bishop and vampire Matthew Clairmont seek refuge in the fascinating and treacherous world of Elizabethan London. There, they must find a powerful witch to help Diana control her magic and search for the elusive Book of Life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As she continues her search for a mentor, Diana meets wealthy alchemist Mary Sidney. London's vampire ruler demands fealty from Diana and Matthew as he is unnerved by their sudden arrival in the City.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In the present, Domenico makes a disturbing discovery in Oxford. Back in 1590, Matthew must beg for forgiveness from Father Hubbard.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Another vicious vampire murder rocks present-day Oxford. Marcus makes a breakthrough.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Matthew and Diana arrive in France on their journey to face Philippe. Elsewhere, Louisa and Kit cut a swathe through London.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Philippe makes a troubling discovery, provoking a conflict with Matthew. Ysabeau, Em and Sarah start to look for a message.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Matthew and Diana go to Bohemia to search for Edward Kelley and the Book of Life. There, they encounter the strange Emperor Rudolf II.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In 1590, Diana is transfixed as she tries to work out what the Book is telling her. Matthew worries over the Book's power.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As Diana and Matthew return to London, Diana learns news that could change everything. The Queen holds Matthew to account.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The second series reaches a dramatic conclusion. Realising that she must return to the present, Diana aims to complete her training.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Matthew and Diana return to a Sept-Tours in chaos, but amid the darkness they get some wonderful news.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Diana is forced to make a confession after being shocked by the appearance of a familiar face - Jack Blackfriars.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In New Orleans, Matthew and Marcus attempt to reconnect with Marcus' unforgiving children. Jack struggles to control his blood rage.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Matthew is relieved at his reconciliation with the New Orleans vampires. Diana, Phoebe and Sarah struggle to find TJ Weston.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Benjamin's plan to bring down the de Clermonts is set into motion, while Matthew and Diana return to Sept-Tours for a christening.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After receiving Benjamin's message, Matthew leaves Sept-Tours to track him down. Diana asks for help to get the Book of Life.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: As Benjamin tortures Matthew to near death, Diana makes plans to rescue him. Revelations from the Book of Life illuminate the long-hidden secrets of creatures.
